# linux_group (Data Source)

Reads a group, like `getent group`. A missing group is not an error: `exists` is `false` and the other attributes are null.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "linux_group" "sudo" {
  name = "sudo"
}

output "sudoers" {
  value = data.linux_group.sudo.members
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group.

### Read-Only

- `exists` (Boolean) Whether the group exists.
- `gid` (Number) Group ID.
- `id` (String) Name of the group.
- `members` (List of String) Users having the group as a supplementary group.
